title: `explode` drops NULL and empty arrays; `explode_outer` keeps a NULL row
verdict: `unnest_null_empty`: no row for NULL or `[]`; `OUTER` adds one NULL row
description: `LATERAL VIEW explode(a)` gives one row per element (a NULL element included) and none for a NULL or empty array; `LATERAL VIEW OUTER explode(a)` (`explode_outer`) gives one row with a NULL element for each. Spark 4.3.0 also has ANSI `UNNEST` in `FROM`: `UNNEST(a)` gives no rows for a NULL or empty array, `WITH ORDINALITY` adds a 1-based `bigint` column, and `UNNEST(a, b)` zips several arrays, padding the shorter ones with NULL (a NULL array counts as empty). `LEFT JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(a) ON true` keeps one row with a NULL element for a NULL or empty array.
reference: `UNNEST`: one row per element, none for an empty list or NULL. Spark's `explode` is native.

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_spark` runs each query four times on one local session: with `spark.sql.ansi.enabled` true and false, on the folded path (the optimizer evaluates a query over `VALUES` on the driver) and on the codegen path (`ConvertToLocalRelation` and `ConstantFolding` excluded, so the query runs as a job with whole-stage code generation). probes.json keeps one result per ANSI setting where the two paths agree. Spark 4.3.0 (pyspark 4.3.0), Java 21.0.12, Linux x86_64, `local[2]`, session time zone UTC, `spark.sql.timestampType=TIMESTAMP_NTZ`.

evidence.note: `explode(array(a, b))` over rows with NULLs gives a row for each NULL element
`explode_outer(cast(null as array<int>))` gives one NULL row
`posexplode_outer(cast(null as array<int>))` gives one row `NULL, NULL`
`UNNEST(array(10, 20, 30)) WITH ORDINALITY` numbers the rows 1 to 3, a `bigint`
`UNNEST(array(1, 2), array(10, 20, 30))` pads the shorter array with NULL
`LATERAL UNNEST(xs, ys) WITH ORDINALITY`: no rows where both are empty; a NULL `xs` beside `array('f')` gives `NULL, f`
`LEFT JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(xs) ON true` gives one NULL row for an empty and for a NULL array

provenance.notes: Spark's SQL query tests at tag v4.3.0: the golden files under results/ run with ANSI on, those under results/nonansi/ with it off.
